import unittest
from copy import deepcopy
from document.service import apply_edits

class Document(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_original_coordinates(self):
        edits=[{'start':4,'end':6,'text':'Z'},{'start':0,'end':1,'text':'LONG'}]
        before=deepcopy(edits)
        self.assertEqual(apply_edits('abcdef',edits),'LONGbcdZ')
        self.assertEqual(edits,before)
        self.assertEqual(apply_edits('A🚲B',[{'start':1,'end':2,'text':'界'},{'start':3,'end':3,'text':'!'}]),'A界B!')
        self.assertEqual(apply_edits('ab',[{'start':0,'end':1,'text':''},{'start':1,'end':2,'text':'x'}]),'x')
        self.assertEqual(apply_edits('',[{'start':0,'end':0,'text':'x'}]),'x')
        self.assertEqual(apply_edits('ok',[]),'ok')
    def test_reject_invalid(self):
        for edits in [
            [{'start':-1,'end':1,'text':''}],
            [{'start':2,'end':1,'text':''}],
            [{'start':0,'end':5,'text':''}],
            [{'start':0.5,'end':1,'text':''}],
            [{'start':0,'end':2,'text':''},{'start':1,'end':3,'text':''}],
            [{'start':1,'end':1,'text':'a'},{'start':1,'end':2,'text':'b'}]]:
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError): apply_edits('abc',edits)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

# document-offset-edits

行为约定：
document.service.apply_edits(text, edits) applies dict edits {start,end,text} using ORIGINAL Unicode-code-point offsets and half-open ranges. Input order is arbitrary. Each range must satisfy 0 <= start <= end <= len(text), with integer offsets. Edits must not overlap and must have distinct starts (including insertions); adjacent ranges are allowed. Empty edits return text. Invalid edits raise ValueError. Do not mutate the edits or their dictionaries.

运行：`python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`。
